test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Mansi is third to the right of Shweta. Shweta is second to the right of Rani. Kajal is fourth to the right of Payal. Payal is to the immediate left of Rani. Laxmi is second to the left of Rani. Monika is immediate neighbour of both Rani and Shweta. Who is third to the left of Monika?
solution:
Eight girls **Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani **are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1. Mansi is third to the right of Shweta.

2. Shweta is second to the right of Rani.

3. Laxmi is second to the left of Rani.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a090748c6d9cea1961737d2b16fecf351e3d938b3cf8bc9af34f6575e485937.png] 

4. Monika is immediate neighbour of both Rani and Shweta.

5. Payal is to the immediate left of Rani.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdf60d895c2b670558a9da3eb0f041872f4f2e039c6d7f77fb5406b1496a10bc.png] 

6. Kajal is fourth to the right of Payal. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8973c08d62cc6e99e67ea5557e25a99625e1c9500ce731e2555cb0a0f49ac9a5.png] 

Aarti, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/825a464160615a7125202fec43c944bb4cf06a6d696c7c927f7af5a27be328bd.png] 

Clearly, Laxmi is third to the left of Monika.

Hence, '**Laxmi**' is the correct answer.
